arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَفْرِشْنِي مِهَادَ كَـرَامَتِـكَ، وَأَوْرِدْنِي مَشَارِعَ رَحْمَتِـكَ، وَأَحْلِلْنِي بُحْبُوحَةَ جَنَّتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ʾafrishnī mihāda karāmatika wa-awridnī mashāriʿa raḥmatik wa ahlilnī buḥbūḥata jannatika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, spread for me the bed of Thy honour, bring me to the wateringholes of Thy mercy, set me down in the midst of Thy Garden,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسُمْنِي بِالرَّدِّ عَنْكَ، وَلا تَحْرِمْنِي بِـالْخَيْبَةِ مِنْـكَ، وَلاَ تُقَاصَّنِي بِمَـا اجْتَرَحْتُ، وَلاَ تُنَاقِشْنِي بِمَا اكْتَسَبْتُ،
transliteration: wa lā tasumnī bil-raddi ʿank walā taḥrimnī bil-khaybah minnak walā tuqāṣṣanī bimā ijtarah-tu wa lā tunāqishnī bimā iktasabtū
english_text: stamp me not with rejection by Thee, deprive me not through disappointment by Thee, settle not accounts with me for what I have committed, make no reckoning with me for what I have earned,

arabic_text: وَلا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي، وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزانِ الأنْصَافِ عَمَلِي، وَلاَ تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلاَءِ خَبَـرِي.
transliteration: walā tubriz maktūmī, walā takhshif mastūrī walā tahmil ʿalā mīzāni'l-ʾinsāfi ʿamalī wala tuʿlin ʿalā ʿuyūni al-malāʾi khabarī
english_text: display not what I have hidden, expose not what I have covered over, weigh not my works on the scales of fairness, and make not my tidings known to the eyes of the crowd!

arabic_text: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَاراً، وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِنْدَكَ شَنَاراً،
transliteration: akhfī ʿanhum mā yakūnu nashruhu ʿalayya ʿāran waṭwi ʿanhum mā yulḥiqunī ʿindaka shanāran
english_text: Conceal from them everything whose unfolding would shame me and roll up before them all which would join me to disgrace with Thee!

arabic_text: شَرِّفْ دَرَجَتِي بِرِضْوَانِكَ، وَأكْمِلْ كَرَامَتِي بِغُفْرَانِكَ، وَانْظِمْنِي فِي أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ، وَوَجِّهْنِي فِي مَسَالِكِ الآمِنِينَ،
transliteration: sharraf darajati bi ridhwanika wa-akmil karāmatī bi-ghufrānik wa anzimni fi ashabil yameen wa wajjihni fi masalikil amineen
english_text: Ennoble my degree through Thy good pleasure, perfect my honour through Thy forgiveness, rank me among the companions of the right hand, direct me to the roads of the secure,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي فَوْجِ الْفَائِزِينَ، وَاعْمُرْ بِي مَجَالِسَ الصَّالِحِينَ،
transliteration: wa-jaʿalnī fī fawj al-fāʾizīn wāʿmur bī majālis aṣ-ṣāliḥīn
english_text: place me in the throng of the triumphant, and through me let the sessions of the righteous thrive!
